sources.excerpt: ement set aside by on Appeal or Review When a Govt. servant already under suspension is dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired but such punishment is set aside on appeal or review and further enquiry is ordered, the order of suspension will be deemed to continue in force from the date of the order of the punishment. Such order shall remain in force until further orders.
